name: firecrawl
label: Firecrawl
description: The context API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
Follow these steps to obtain your Firecrawl API Key:

1. Sign in or create an account at [Firecrawl](https://www.firecrawl.dev/app/api-keys?utm_source=activepieces&utm_medium=integration).
2. Copy your API key from the API Keys page.

scrape.label: Scrape Website
scrape.description: Read one web page as Markdown, HTML, links, a screenshot or JSON.

useActions.label: Run Browser Actions
useActions.description: Click, type or wait on the page before it is read.

formats.label: Output Format
formats.description: What the step returns for the page.

timeout.label: Timeout
timeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for the page to load.

storeInCache.label: Use Cache
storeInCache.description: On: Firecrawl keeps the page and may serve a cached copy.

map.label: Map Website
map.description: List the links found on a website.

url.label: Website URL
url.description: The site to list links from.

subdomain.label: Include Subdomains
subdomain.description: Also list pages on subdomains, like blog.example.com.

limit.label: Max Links
limit.description: Most links to return, up to 100,000.

scrape_url.label: Scrape URL
scrape_url.description: Fetch the content of a single web page in a chosen format.

url.label: URL
url.description: The exact web page URL to scrape (e.g. https://example.com/about). Obtain candidate URLs from Search Web or Map Website if you do not already have one.

format.label: Output Format
format.description: Which representation of the page to return.

onlyMainContent.label: Only Main Content
onlyMainContent.description: Return only the main content of the page, excluding headers, navs, footers, etc.

timeout.label: Timeout (ms)
timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for the page to load, in milliseconds.

get_crawl_results.label: Get Crawl Results
get_crawl_results.description: Get the status and accumulated page results of a crawl job by its ID.

crawlId.label: Crawl ID
crawlId.description: The ID of the crawl job to check. Obtain it from the Crawl Website action result or from List Active Crawls.

map_website.label: Map Website
map_website.description: Discover and return the list of URLs reachable from a website.

url.label: Website URL
url.description: The website URL to map (e.g. https://example.com).

search.label: Search Filter
search.description: Optional keyword to filter the discovered URLs (e.g. "blog" to return only blog paths).

includeSubdomains.label: Include Subdomains
includeSubdomains.description: Include pages from subdomains (e.g. blog.example.com) in addition to the main domain.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of links to return (max: 100,000).

get_batch_scrape_results.label: Get Batch Scrape Results
get_batch_scrape_results.description: Get the status and accumulated page results of a batch scrape job by its ID.

jobId.label: Batch Scrape Job ID
jobId.description: The ID of the batch scrape job to check. Obtain it from the Batch Scrape action result.

get_batch_scrape_errors.label: Get Batch Scrape Errors
get_batch_scrape_errors.description: List the URLs that failed in a batch scrape job.

jobId.label: Batch Scrape Job ID
jobId.description: The ID of the batch scrape job whose errors to list. Obtain it from the Batch Scrape action result.

cancel_batch_scrape.label: Cancel Batch Scrape
cancel_batch_scrape.description: Cancel an in-flight batch scrape job by its ID.

jobId.label: Batch Scrape Job ID
jobId.description: The ID of the batch scrape job to cancel. Obtain it from the Batch Scrape action result.

get_crawl_errors.label: Get Crawl Errors
get_crawl_errors.description: List the URLs that failed or were blocked in a crawl job.

crawlId.label: Crawl ID
crawlId.description: The ID of the crawl job whose errors to list. Obtain it from the Crawl Website action result or List Active Crawls.

cancel_crawl.label: Cancel Crawl
cancel_crawl.description: Cancel an in-flight crawl job by its ID.

crawlId.label: Crawl ID
crawlId.description: The ID of the crawl job to cancel. Obtain it from the Crawl Website action result or List Active Crawls.

list_active_crawls.label: List Active Crawls
list_active_crawls.description: List the account's in-flight crawl jobs.

search_web.label: Search Web
search_web.description: Search the web, news, or images for a query. Optionally include each result page as markdown.

query.label: Query
query.description: The search query (keywords, like a Google search).

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of results to return for each source (max 100).

lang.label: Language
lang.description: Optional ISO language code to bias results (e.g. "en").

country.label: Country
country.description: Optional ISO country code to bias results (e.g. "us").

timeout.label: Timeout (ms)
timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for the search, in milliseconds. Allow more time when Include Page Content is on.

sources.label: Sources
sources.description: Where to search: "web", "news" or "images". Defaults to web only.

timeFilter.label: Time Filter
timeFilter.description: Only return results from this time range: qdr:h (past hour), qdr:d (past day), qdr:w (past week), qdr:m (past month) or qdr:y (past year). Leave empty for any time.

location.label: Location
location.description: Optional location to search from (e.g. "San Francisco,California,United States").

includePageContent.label: Include Page Content
includePageContent.description: Also return each result page as markdown (for image results, the page the image is on). Each result with page content uses scrape credits.

start_agent.label: Start Agent
start_agent.description: Start an autonomous Firecrawl (FIRE-1) agent job from a natural-language prompt.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: Natural-language instruction describing what the agent should accomplish.

urls.label: URLs
urls.description: Optional starting URLs for the agent. Obtain them from Search Web or Map Website if needed.

schema.label: Result Schema
schema.description: Optional JSON Schema describing the structured result to produce.

maxCredits.label: Max Credits
maxCredits.description: Optional credit budget cap for the agent run.

strictConstrainToURLs.label: Strictly Constrain to URLs
strictConstrainToURLs.description: If enabled, the agent may only visit the provided URLs and will not navigate elsewhere.

get_agent_status.label: Get Agent Status
get_agent_status.description: Get the status and result of a Firecrawl (FIRE-1) agent job by its ID.

jobId.label: Agent Job ID
jobId.description: The ID of the agent job to check. Obtain it from the Start Agent action result.
